title: Registration authority
rule: The published participant directory is authoritative for participant identity, organization, active status and event eligibility. Invitations alone do not confirm registration.

title: Refunds
rule: Cancellation at least seven days before the event qualifies for a full refund. Later cancellations require staff review.

title: Check-in schedule
rule: Check-in opens at 08:30. The programme starts at 09:00. Registration closes on 12 November 2026 at 17:00 SAST.

title: Contact verification
rule: An active directory match, explicit registration evidence and a matching invitation are required for verified export. Missing, duplicate or conflicting records require review.
